_comment: Partial snapshot of the in-progress reversed-order Atari run (seed 0). Transcribed from the gitignored results/atari5_rev_*_seed0/eval_matrix.json + status.json on the cluster so viz can be built from a tracked source. eval_matrix[i] = greedy-100 scores on tasks 0..i AFTER finishing (local+consolidation) task i. Rows are lower-triangular and grow as tasks complete. Re-transcribe when the run advances.
_method_naming: The cka_rl entry below is CKA-RL ONLY. It was previously labelled "CLEAR / CKA-RL", which led to it being read as the CLEAR run. CLEAR is a separate method and a separate run, joint-training run records, atari5_clear_order2_seed0, transcribed into reports/order_sensitivity/data.json as matrices.clear_reversed. Their final rows differ: CKA-RL [212.55, -15.46, 6.69, -21.0, 4420.5], CLEAR [505.85, 36.8, 23.9, 11.1, 15350.75].

notes.value_vs_score: Ours Breakout value-constraint shortfall reached ~0 yet the greedy diagonal fell 396->77.6 during consolidation: the documented value-vs-score mismatch. Retention of PAST tasks is strong (SI recovered 498.5->793.2, +BWT; Boxing held ~60).
notes.cka_rl_boxing_collapse: CKA-RL forgot Boxing catastrophically (90.5 -> -8.3 -> -22.5 -> -15.5, below random) and SI 641.5 -> 212.6. Only the last-learned Qbert (4420.5) survives.
notes.breakout_recovery: Ours Breakout recovered non-monotonically 77.6 (T2 diag) -> 144.5 (T3, after Pong consolidation). SI kept climbing 793.2 -> 874.4 (+BWT).
notes.componet_plasticity: CompoNet has zero forgetting by construction (frozen components, constant lower triangle) but failed late plasticity: Qbert 0.0 (never learned) and Breakout only 99.2 (threshold 285).
notes.ours_final: DONE 5/5. Final-row (after Qbert) normalized retention of prior-4: SI 0.817, Boxing 0.155, Breakout 0.825, Pong 0.943 -> mean 0.685. Qbert diag 5195.2 (>4260 thr, >4750 local). Breakout recovered non-monotonically 77.6->144.5->235.6. Boxing is the casualty (69->60->42.5->10.5).
notes.ours_vs_baselines: Normalized: prior-4 retention ours 0.685 vs CompoNet 0.828 (frozen, but Qbert 0.0) vs CKA-RL -0.034. all-5 mean: ours 0.794 vs CompoNet 0.655 vs CKA-RL 0.181. Ours is the only method that learns every task AND retains the past.
notes.boxing_topup_ablation: Post-hoc Boxing recovery from the final global was tried 3 ways and ALL discarded (net-negative): 10-iter pure (Boxing +2.3, Breakout -159/Qbert -1648, SI +625 = eval noise); 100-iter pure (Boxing +36 but Qbert -4424); 100-iter 40/60 Boxing/rest mix (Boxing +23.5, net -0.81 norm). Conclusion: a forgotten task can't be patched post-hoc without net loss -> motivates in-sequence best-checkpoint. Final matrix stands unchanged.
notes.model_selection: This run kept the FINAL (iter-2000 / early-stop) global per phase, NOT best-checkpoint (the global trainer had no best-ckpt at run time). Best-ckpt has since been added+verified for future runs.
